description: Cynex MCP server: an agent requests settlement with a scoped settle-only key while the NEAR vault enforces the human-authorized terms. Includes a local sandbox demo mode (npx cynex-mcp --sandbox) that runs the real vault on a local chain with five seeded obligations.
name: cynex-mcp

scripts.build: NODE_PATH=./node_modules esbuild cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:near-api-js --outfile=dist/cynex-mcp.mjs --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node" && chmod +x dist/cynex-mcp.mjs
